versions.changelog:
- No code or documentation changes in this version.
- Version bump only; content remains unchanged.

Initial release of API Rate Limiter Designer.

- Provides guidance on selecting and implementing API rate limiting strategies (token bucket, sliding window, fixed window, leaky bucket).
- Analyzes API traffic and recommends appropriate algorithms with configuration details.
- Generates sample implementation code for frameworks like Express using Redis-backed distributed rate limiting.
- Offers design patterns for per-user, per-IP, per-endpoint, and tier-based limits.
- Includes practical tips on response headers, edge cases, and Redis usage for scalable rate limiting.
